name: @xperience-community/xperience-search-themes
description: shell.css and the two palettes of the design theme for @xperience-community/xperience-search, plus the markup fixtures they are built against.

scripts.check: node scripts/build-css.mjs --check && node scripts/check.mjs && node scripts/build-test-page.mjs --check && node scripts/check-isolation.mjs && node scripts/check-layout.mjs && node scripts/check-sheet.mjs
scripts.size: node -e "const z=require('zlib'),f=require('fs');for(const n of ['shell','default','kentico-violet','kentico-orange']){const s=f.readFileSync('src/'+n+'.css');console.log(n+'.css: '+s.length+' B raw, '+z.gzipSync(s,{level:9}).length+' B gzipped')}"
